name: urscript
description: Code snippet and completion items for Universal Robots Script

urscript.autocomplete.methodCommitCharac.description:
The commit characters that trigger autocomplete of methods. E.g. `r2d`, `movej`
Please use escape symbol or symbol name. E.g. ( \t | tab ) for tab, ( \n | newline | enter) for newline, (Space) for space

urscript.autocomplete.keywordCommitChara.description:
The commit characters that trigger autocomplete of keywords. E.g. `def`, `end`
Please use escape symbol or symbol name. E.g. ( \t | tab ) for tab, ( \n | newline | enter) for newline, (Space) for space

urscript.autocomplete.urdocCommitCharact.description:
The commit characters that trigger autocomplete of UrDoc paragraph (###)
Please use escape symbol or symbol name. E.g. ( \t | tab ) for tab, ( \n | newline | enter) for newline, (Space) for space

urscript.autocomplete.urdocTagCommitChar.description:

Please use escape symbol or symbol name. E.g. ( \t | tab ) for tab, ( \n | newline | enter) for newline, (Space) for space
